title: Information-Theoretic Decoupled Prompt Tuning for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.26257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning (CL) aims to incrementally acquire knowledge from sequential data while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Recently, prompt tuning has attracted increasing attention as an efficient approach for adapting pre-trained models to CL tasks. However, existing prompt design paradigms commonly suffer from retrieval dependence and classifier bias, which make model adaptation sensitive to prompt selection and bias predictions toward newly arrived classes. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Prompt Tuning for Continual Learning (DPT4CL), which decouples the CLIP textual prompt into a task-shared prompt distribution and class-specific prompts. The task-shared prompt distribution is derived by optimizing an Information Bottleneck objective to facilitate cross-task knowledge transfer and alleviate classifier bias, while class-specific prompts enhance inter-class separability without relying on explicit prompt retrieval.

translated_title: 面向持续学习的信息论解耦提示调优
translated_abstract: 持续学习（CL）旨在从序列数据中增量地获取知识，同时避免灾难性遗忘。近年来，提示调优作为一种将预训练模型高效适配到持续学习任务的方法，受到了越来越多的关注。然而，现有的提示设计范式普遍存在检索依赖和分类器偏差问题，这使得模型适配对提示选择十分敏感，并使预测偏向新出现的类别。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了面向持续学习的解耦提示调优方法（DPT4CL），该方法将CLIP的文本提示解耦为任务共享的提示分布和类别特定的提示。任务共享的提示分布通过优化信息瓶颈目标得到，以促进跨任务知识迁移并缓解分类器偏差；而类别特定的提示则无需依赖显式提示检索即可增强类间可分性。
tldr: 提出DPT4CL方法，将CLIP文本提示解耦为通过信息瓶颈目标优化的任务共享提示分布和类别特定提示，从而解决持续学习中的检索依赖和分类器偏差问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes DPT4CL, which decouples CLIP textual prompts into an information-bottleneck-optimized task-shared prompt distribution and class-specific prompts to overcome retrieval dependence and classifier bias in continual learning.
